import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem final_dev_0069 (l : List Nat) : List.sum (l ++ [0]) = List.sum l + 0 := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem final_dev_0069 (l : List Nat) : List.sum (l ++ [0]) = List.sum l + 0 := by
  induction l with
  | nil => 
    simp [List.sum]
  | cons x xs ih => 
    simp [List.sum, ih]
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : @Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0069 = @Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0069 := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
#print axioms Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0069

  let candidateType := candidateInfo.type.instantiateLevelParams candidateInfo.levelParams (expectedInfo.levelParams.map Lean.Level.param)
